name: Fire Shield
rationale: Blaze and a protection seal meet Iron resistance and opposing cold to ward and burn nearby attackers.

parts.rationale: Native cold substitute for Iron Frozen Bone

clues: Outer Plinths hold flame focus; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the second outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Leave the third outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Leave the fourth outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Flame focus follows blank inscription clockwise.
Protection seal follows flame focus clockwise.
Bound metal follows protection seal clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Cold focus follows bound metal clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Blank inscription follows cold focus clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
